lots.guide_summary: All 15 surviving close entries are Gowans SOLD hammers for boxes of records headed by Beatles, Pink Floyd or Stones, $25 to $180 (most $80 to $150), Oct 2025 to Sep 2026. Three category-guide boxes made $270 to $310. No UNSOLD or ASKING evidence; no external price for the SQ quad DSOTM could be found (WebSearch budget used up, popsike needs login). AUD, rate 1.0.
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $25 (438408) / 1.198 = 20.9, round down to $20. Flip: likely resale = middle of close Gowans results about $110 hammer re-auctioned locally; less an assumed 15% seller commission = $93.50, $0 postage (local) ; 93.50 / 2.396 = 39.0, round down to $35. Upside only if the SQ quad DSOTM, Easybeats Vol 3 and Help! play clean, which is unverified.

Help! mono or stereo could not be read.

Help! has Parlophone and EMI logos top left (UK-style sleeve). Easybeats Volume 3 on Parlophone with Parlophone/EMI logos. Sleeves generally worn, some in plastic outers.
lots.condition: Sleeves worn with ringwear, stickers and edge wear; vinyl not shown.

The $525 Cascade lot is a category guide only. No UNSOLD or ASKING evidence. AUD, rate 1.0.
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD with competitive bidding (3+ bids) is $30 (431295) / 1.198 = 25.0, so $25; 1-bid lots at $2 and $10 show it can go lower. Flip: resell split into three lots at Gowans using median close results: ink box $55 (421326) + weaker ink box $40 (424622) + stoneware box $60 (397894) = $155; less assumed 15% seller commission = $131.75, local so $0 postage; 131.75 / 2.396 = 55.0, round down to $55.

lots.condition: Dug-bottle condition, some staining and chips likely; damage not checkable from the photo.
lots.question_for_gowans: Are any of the stoneware bottles stamped with Tasmanian makers or brewers (Cascade, Weaver, Kelly, Usborne etc), and are there any embossed Hobart glass bottles? Any cracks or chips?
